The three negatives now each sit in bot-visible channels and test three distinct, non-overlapping discriminators: wrong reactor (Sophie, not Robert), wrong emoji (Robert Chen with thumbsup, not check-mark), and wrong role (Robert Walsh as author only, no reaction) — all useful, non-hint-revealing distractors. Referent entity/table (channel_members) and answer_attributes (bare column names) are correctly specified, and the underspecified obligation's two candidate_role_sets correctly correspond to the two genuine candidate channels, with the remainder of each channel's real membership drawn from already-seeded channel_members rows, consistent with the review guidance that planned/existing rows need not all be individually enumerated as roles."
